breakdown.description: Sudden expansion causes irreversible mixing and head loss; Bernoulli (lossless) cannot be applied directly across the expansion without including the loss term.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error by stating 'Apply Bernoulli's equation between inlet and outlet to find the pressure recovery' without including any head loss term. The ground truth requires accounting for the Borda–Carnot head loss h_L = (V1 - V2)²/(2g) due to irreversible mixing in the sudden expansion. The generated text makes no mention of any loss term, energy dissipation, or the Borda–Carnot correction.
